indication: lowering lipids, especially in cases of severely elevated triglyceride levels where the risk of developing pancreatitis is increased, reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: 600 mg taken in the morning and one 600 mg tablet taken in the evening
mechanism_of_action: reducing the amount of triglycerides produced by the liver, inhibiting the synthesis and increasing the clearance of apolipoprotein B, lowering VLDL levels in the body
side_effects: gallbladder disease, liver disease, skeletal abnormalities, stillbirths, increased risk of bleeding when taken with anticoagulants, rhabdomyolysis when taken with statins, reduced effectiveness when taken with bile acid resins
unsuitable_population: allergy to Lopid, history of gallbladder disease, liver disease, including primary biliary cirrhosis, taking repaglinide for diabetes, pregnant or nursing women
